title: OpenDesign Intelligent Router is here
body:
Understand your intent in one sentence and route the best skills straight to the work you want to create.
Share work with a link so people can view it and comment exactly where changes are needed.
Motion videos track smoothly, with audio dropouts and glitches fixed for steadier sync.

zh-CN.title: OpenDesign Intelligent Router 正式上线
zh-CN.body:
一句话就懂你：自动路由优质 skill，直奔你想要的作品
支持链接分享作品：对方点开就能看，想改哪里就评哪里
动效视频丝滑跟拍：修复音频断续、跳音问题，音画同步更稳
